paper_id: LoongTrain_ Efficient Training of Long-Sequence LLMs with Head-Context Parallelism
title: LoongTrain: Efficient Training of Long-Sequence LLMs with Head-Context Parallelism
motivation: 长序列LLM训练面临内存与算力瓶颈,现有序列并行方案在扩展性或通信效率上存在根本性制约
problem_framing: Ulysses-Attention受限于注意力头数量,扩展性有上限; Ring-Attention的P2P通信开销在高并行度下成为瓶颈
key_insight: 将head-parallel与context-parallel组成二维网格d_hp×d_cp,在突破扩展性限制的同时通过限制d_cp减少P2P步骤
method_signature: 2D-Attention(d_hp×d_cp grid) + Double-Ring-Attention(inner/outer rings) + 设备放置策略
evaluation_criteria: Model FLOPs Utilization(MFU), 端到端训练吞吐量(TGS), GPU扩展规模(64-512 GPUs), 序列长度(128K-1M)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: KV replication会增大网络通信量; d_cp过大时需跨节点通信; Double-Ring-Attention在长序列时效果受限(通信已可被计算覆盖)
evidence_for_taste: P2P encounters issues of low intra-node bandwidth utilization
communication overheads when scaling out the context-parallel dimension
computation time per micro-step decreases linearly when d_cp is increased
SeqAlltoAll leverages the intra-node high-bandwidth NVLINK
the global batch size poses a challenge for the computation-communication ratio
Ring-Attention encounters bottlenecks due to the P2P communication
bubble rate reaches 2 even under zero-bubble mechanisms
thinking_moves: 从硬件拓扑不对称性(节点内600GB/s vs 节点间400GB/s)推导设备放置策略差异
将head-parallel和context-parallel的各自局限转化为互补优势: HP受头数约束但通信高效, CP可无限扩展但通信昂贵
用比例分析揭示Ring-Attention的渐近瓶颈: 计算时间随d_cp平方下降,通信量仅线性减少
承认KV replication的双刃剑效应: 解锁d_hp扩展但增加网络流量
